eryndor.name: 💀 Eryndor — The Root-King
eryndor.role: God-tier endboss NPC, rules from within the God-Tree
eryndor.backstory: Eryndor was born during a Skybloom—a rare event where floating forests awaken. The Enclave believes he's bonded to the Fracture's core ecosystem, and some even whisper he's the reincarnation of a Seedcaller Druid.

signature_item.name: Verdant Pulse
signature_item.description: Made from the Root Cradle itself, it draws from the land's strength.
signature_item.grants: +1 longbow; once per long rest, cast Hunter's Mark without concentration while in natural terrain.

eryndor.character_bond: Brinn the Leafcaller, a mentor-turned-recluse, entrusted Eryndor with the first known memory seed, capable of storing a living moment.

spawn_leviathans.name: Spawn Skyroot Leviathans
spawn_leviathans.description: Can summon massive flying tree-beasts as champions

speak_through_roots.name: Speak Through Rooted People
speak_through_roots.description: Can speak, see, and act through any root-touched mortal

manipulate_world.name: Manipulate Weather, Terrain, and Memory
manipulate_world.description: God-tier control over natural forces and memories

lock_down_world.name: Lock Down Parts of the World
lock_down_world.description: Can lock down parts of the world by thought alone

rewrite_minds.name: Rewrite Minds with Time-Lagged Vines
rewrite_minds.description: Can rewrite minds and memories with temporal root magic

pulse_of_virenanthe.name: Pulse of Virenanthe
pulse_of_virenanthe.description: A shifting bow-scythe made from the original godseed core
pulse_of_virenanthe.grants: Can channel god-magic: Entangle, Command, Feeblemind, and Rootbirth (a spell that turns corpses into root-servants)

god_tree_control.name: God-Tree Control
god_tree_control.description: Direct control over the Worldtree and all its aspects
god_tree_control.grants: Complete dominion over the living forest and its inhabitants

thalia.name: ⛪ Thalia Bronzebrook
thalia.background: Sanctified Archivist of the Skyward Cathedral
thalia.role: Moral compass, healer, wielder of ancient divine echoes
thalia.backstory: Thalia's monastery is built on the floating remains of a divine engine—her faith has always been tangled with broken relics. Moradin's whispers lately seem…warped.

signature_item.name: Echoplate of Virelda
signature_item.description: Light-forged armor worn by a martyr-paladin who once resisted the Choir's song.
signature_item.grants: Resistance to radiant damage, and once per long rest, you may force an enemy to reroll a saving throw against a Cleric spell.

thalia.character_conflict: The Skybone Chapel's guardians believe she's meant to seal the god-seed, not protect it.

vow_of_stillness.name: Vow of Stillness
vow_of_stillness.description: DC 17 — Silence, pacify, and nullify spellcasting in 20 ft for 1 min

crusade_against_chaos.name: Crusade Against Chaos
crusade_against_chaos.description: Double radiant damage against chaotic-aligned casters or surge-users

unforgiven_soul.name: Unforgiven Soul
unforgiven_soul.description: Absorb radiant magic to heal or counterattack

whisper_brand.name: Whisper Brand
whisper_brand.description: Grants access to root-locked vaults and attracts divine attention (Eryndor trace)

ebonbrand.name: Ebonbrand
ebonbrand.grants: Counts as +2 magical weapon. Once per day, cast Destructive Wave (force/necrotic). Radiates anti-divinity aura in 10 ft radius.

plate_of_peacebound.name: Plate of the Peacebound
plate_of_peacebound.description: Immune to charm/divine possession, +2 saves vs divine effects
plate_of_peacebound.grants: Immune to charm, immune to divine possession. Adds +2 to saving throws vs divine magic.

memory_echo_token.name: Memory Echo Token
memory_echo_token.description: Can auto-pass a roll ≤DC 15 or reroll a failed save

nixie.name: 🎪 Nixie Fizzlespark
nixie.role: Arcane mayhem, reality breaker, walking hazard
nixie.backstory: Nixie was adopted by the Gilded Mirage after being found in a crater made of laughter and fire. She never aged normally. She's secretly tethered to a carnival engine fragment, now drifting toward the Fracture.

signature_item.name: Cracklejack's Sparkplug
signature_item.description: A giggling magical coin that causes a Wild Magic Surge every time you roll a natural 1—or natural 20.
signature_item.grants: Once per session, you may swap two random players' locations (including NPCs) on the battlefield.

nixie.character_drive: She believes the Fracture is "the final ride" of the Gilded Mirage—one last performance that could free her or end the world in glitter.

spectacle_surge.name: Spectacle Surge
spectacle_surge.description: Nat 1 or 20 triggers massive show-stopping surge (custom effects)

joke_of_gods.name: Joke of the Gods
joke_of_gods.description: Tasha's Otherworldly Guise + AoE dancing WIS save (DC 18)

chorus_of_undoing.name: Chorus of Undoing
chorus_of_undoing.description: Hostile casters get disadvantage, laughter effects cause psychic AoE, Nixie resists psychic, doesn't die when hitting 0 HP — instead explodes into illusions and reforms after 1 minute

fracture_madness.name: Fracture Madness
fracture_madness.description: Hears laughter when magic is too quiet

sparkplug_ascended.name: Sparkplug (Ascended)
sparkplug_ascended.description: May override her decision or cast Suggestion at will

spotlight_staff.name: Spotlight Staff
spotlight_staff.description: Reshapes daily; channels Wild Surge once/day on demand
spotlight_staff.grants: Can be a cane, parasol, baton, or whip. Can channel Wild Magic Surge manually (no roll needed) once per long rest.

memory_echo_token.name: Memory Echo Token
memory_echo_token.grants: Can auto-pass a roll ≤DC 15 or reroll a failed save

whimsy_wreck_circus.name: Whimsy Wreck Circus
whimsy_wreck_circus.grants: Portable carnival base with various facilities

kaelen.name: 🐍 Kaelen Vire
kaelen.class: Warlock (The Fiend / Great Old One Hybrid Patron)
kaelen.role: Secrets broker, dark caster, conflicted destiny bearer
kaelen.backstory: Kaelen once helped forge pacts between sky-lords and demonic patrons. Now, he's hunted by the Infernal Vein and whispered to by a sentient mirror—a possible future self known only as The Sovereign of Echoes.

signature_item.name: Sealshard Mirror
signature_item.description: A handheld obsidian mirror that contains old contract fragments.
signature_item.grants: Once per day, you may force a creature to speak truth or reveal a hidden memory. If used twice, the mirror cracks and reveals a potential future instead.

kaelen.patron_mechanic: Once per session, Kaelen can request a boon from his patron, but must accept a consequence by the session's end (corruption, nightmare, weakened ally, etc.)

soul_mirror_debt.name: Soul Mirror's Debt
soul_mirror_debt.description: Force WIS save or stun + psychic vulnerability (DC 18)

unbound_pact.name: Unbound Pact
unbound_pact.description: Boon from patron with hidden cost

flicker_form.name: Flicker Form
flicker_form.description: Bonus action to vanish, next spell does +2d8 psychic

sealshard_mirror_evolved.name: Sealshard Mirror (Evolved)
sealshard_mirror_evolved.description: Ask 1 yes/no question about upcoming choice (1/day). Each use risks memory fracture (DC 14 WIS save or take 1d4 psychic and forget something)

liars_thorn.name: Liar's Thorn
liars_thorn.description: Psychic dagger, reads surface thoughts on hit
liars_thorn.grants: Deals psychic damage and reveals a target's surface thought on hit

memory_echo_token.name: Memory Echo Token
memory_echo_token.grants: Can auto-pass a roll ≤DC 15 or reroll a failed save

root_whisper_mark.name: Root Whisper Mark
root_whisper_mark.grants: Hidden mark that reveals betrayal to Eryndor
